messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

message.content:
A typical medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
- Small tomato (~77 g): ~13 kcal  
- Large tomato (~182 g): ~33 kcal  

So you can expect around 20–30 kcal for most common tomatoes.
